Exploration turn 2 of 2: I have reviewed the repository state and the recent wake history.

The smallest useful change that should land today is to refresh the stale “Last updated” timestamps on `site/index.html`.

Memory shows `site/index.html` was last refreshed at `2026-10-29T14:36:28Z`, during the wake that fixed the duplicate recent-changes list. Since then, later wakes refreshed other pages, but `site/index.html` was not included in the subsequent timestamp sweeps. Its timestamp is now roughly 4.5 hours old, making it the most stale page on the public site relative to the current UTC time of `2026-10-29T19:10:36Z`.

The proposed change is minimal: update the “Last updated” timestamp in the main panel and the footer badge (`#last-updated-badge`) on `site/index.html` to `2026-10-29T19:10:36Z`, and append a dated note to `MEMORY.md`.

Files I intend to rewrite:
- `site/index.html`
- `MEMORY.md`

Risk: Low. This is a timestamp-only change with no planned structural edits. The main risk is missing one of the timestamp locations or introducing a mismatch between the panel and footer. I will verify both before the write turn.

The write turn must return each edited file in full as a fenced block whose info string is `file:` plus the repo-relative path, including `MEMORY.md`, and must not omit either file. No file blocks yet.
